patterns.name: 〜で (cause)
patterns.explanation: で after a thing can give the reason something happens or does not happen. ＊で　まひしない = 'is not paralyzed thanks to ＊'.

patterns.name: 〜ない
patterns.explanation: ない on the end of a verb says it does not happen; しない is the 'not' form of する. まひしない = 'does not get paralyzed'.
